rationale: The gloss "name" here refers to "Ingwine" as a proper name/designation for a people or group (friends of Ing, a name for the Danes in Beowulf), which is a straightforward linguistic label by which a group is known. The attestations from Beowulf confirm it is used as a proper designation, matching the basic sense of name.n.01 rather than any reputational or figurative sense.
